mapper.insert: INSERT INTO w14_egg_evaluation_scope(evaluation_key,member_id,scope_kind,owner_id,release_id, occurrence_id,definition_id,definition_version,definition_fingerprint,status,evidence_level,revision) VALUES(#{evaluationKey},#{memberId},#{scopeKind},#{ownerId},#{releaseId},#{occurrenceId}, #{definitionId},#{definitionVersion},#{definitionFingerprint},'ACTIVE','ISOLATED_EVALUATION',1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE evaluation_key=evaluation_key
mapper.select: SELECT evaluation_key AS evaluationKey,member_id AS memberId,scope_kind AS scopeKind,owner_id AS ownerId, release_id AS releaseId,occurrence_id AS occurrenceId,definition_id AS definitionId, definition_version AS definitionVersion,definition_fingerprint AS definitionFingerprint,status, evidence_level AS evidenceLevel,revision FROM w14_egg_evaluation_scope WHERE evaluation_key=#{evaluationKey} AND member_id=#{memberId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT evaluation_key AS evaluationKey,member_id AS memberId,receipt_id AS receiptId, definition_fingerprint AS definitionFingerprint,discovered_at AS discoveredAt, history_hashes AS historyHashes,evidence_level AS evidenceLevel FROM w14_egg_evaluation_receipt WHERE evaluation_key=#{evaluationKey} AND member_id=#{memberId} FOR UPDATE
